name: browser_matrix_function_table
source:
{ Browser end-to-end proof: a MATRIX solve, a user FUNCTION and a TABLE lookup
  in one document, all resolved by the same Tarjan/Newton path. }
TABLE htc(re)
  1000   50
  2000   80
  4000   120
END

FUNCTION Scale(v)
  Scale := 2 * v + 1
END

A = [2 1; 1 3]
b = [5; 10]
x = SolveLinear(A, b)

Re = 3000
U = htc(Re)
S = Scale(U)
Q = S * x[1]
